intro: A chosen subword pair must be replaced consistently without consuming the same original token twice.
task: Apply one left-to-right, non-overlapping BPE pair merge to a token list and return a new list.
requirements: tokens is a list of nonempty strings and may be empty. pair is a two-element list or tuple of nonempty strings.
When consecutive original tokens match pair, concatenate them with no separator and advance by two. Otherwise copy one token.
Do not recursively merge newly formed tokens during this pass. Preserve all other tokens and their order.
Do not modify inputs. Raise ValueError for the invalid shapes, ranges, or non-finite numeric inputs described above. Numerical checks use moderate finite values unless stated otherwise.

hints.title: Choose the representation
hints.body: Maintain a position index and advance it by two after a match, otherwise by one.

hints.title: Check the boundary
hints.body: A newly created token belongs in output only; do not put it back into the input scan.

explanation: A BPE merge replaces a selected pair of adjacent tokens with one token. It operates on token boundaries rather than arbitrary substrings inside a token.
A left-to-right pass makes overlapping matches deterministic. Consuming a matched pair advances two positions, so neither original token is reused.
Compare the pair count for a,a,a with the number of replacements in one pass. Explain why pair statistics can count overlaps even though a concrete segmentation cannot contain overlapping tokens.
